cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. It's your bin night. The rota puts you on Tuesdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And I took your Thursday. The swap box says 'one week only.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your request, so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. It protects your Tuesday too.
